suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as pulmonary disease complication. Require documented bronchiectasis and separately established bronchiectasis-associated pulmonary hypertension, preferably with appropriate hemodynamic evidence such as right-heart catheterization when clinically available, and evaluation sufficient to distinguish major alternative causes of pulmonary hypertension. PMID 38860405 supports the established bronchiectasis-associated PH phenotype and its prognostic hemodynamics; it should not be used to estimate PH incidence in unselected bronchiectasis or to infer PH from bronchiectasis severity alone. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Bronchiectasis and Pulmonary Hypertension
